description: Utility functions for ERPNext setup, including tree structure navigation, test setup, exchange rate retrieval, role/domain enabling, record insertion, and welcome email generation.

methods.name: get_root_of
methods.description: Retrieves the root element of a tree-structured DocType.

methods.name: get_ancestors_of
methods.description: Retrieves ancestor elements of a tree-structured DocType.

methods.name: before_tests
methods.description: Prepares the environment for testing, including setup of default data and clearing caches.

methods.name: get_exchange_rate
methods.description: Fetches the exchange rate between two currencies, using cache or external API if necessary.

methods.name: enable_all_roles_and_domains
methods.description: Enables all roles and domains for testing purposes.

methods.name: set_defaults_for_tests
methods.description: Sets default values for certain settings used in tests.

methods.name: insert_record
methods.description: Inserts multiple records into the database, ignoring duplicates.

methods.name: welcome_email
methods.description: Generates a welcome email title based on the default company.
